label: OpenLigaDB (Fußball-Bundesliga und weitere Ligen)
terms_note: Free sports data, no key (OpenAPI 3.0.4 at https://api.openligadb.de/swagger/v1/swagger.json, descriptions in German). The spec's own description: 'Es gilt ein Limit von 60 Anfragen pro Minute und IP' and 'Bitte sparsam abrufen' (poll /getlastchangedate first). The spec lists no servers (the API host is the default) and text/plain before application/json; the API answers JSON. An unknown league or season answers 200 [] (no error). Tables have no rank field: rows come in table order.

discover.note: Every league-season OpenLigaDB carries (about 830: Bundesliga 'bl1/2025', 2. Bundesliga 'bl2/2025', DFB-Pokal, also other sports); id is 'leagueShortcut/season'. query matches the name, id or sport; kind the sport name (Fußball ...).

standings.note: League table in table order (first row = first place; rank is not given by the API). competition_id is 'leagueShortcut/season' (bl1/2025). goals, goalDiff, won/draw/lost in raw.

not_offered.get_competition: There is no endpoint for one league-season's details (only the full list in discover and match data per matchday).

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
